InstCombineAtomicRMW.cpp.notes: All four successful visitAtomicRMWInst outcomes are inventoried separately by saturating-value replacement, negated add/sub canonicalization, integer idempotent canonicalization, and floating idempotent canonicalization. The shared isSaturating/isIdempotentRMW predicates are represented through exact per-record case guards; the atomicrmw instruction itself remains unsupported by Puddle.
